split_policy.primary_axis: phase owner contract before fixture path convenience, docs/evidence surface, generated manifest, retired surface, or absent-support row
split_policy.positive_rule: positive support claims must remain hand-authored tests/native behavior evidence owned by parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e split contracts
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: docs, issue evidence, source_basis text, and cross-index references are provenance only and cannot create behavior support
split_policy.generated_rule: generated-only contracts are provenance-only and cannot satisfy phase support claims
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, evidence-log, generated-only, migration-only, retired-source, unsupported-feature, and alternate acceptance contracts are strict rejection, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
